parent_objective: export train and validation capability corpora before repair optimizer smoke

public_gates: verify pair rows and target summaries are non-empty
verify labels remain targets only and actor observation dim is 72
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add capability labels or hidden physical parameters to actor observations
do not claim driver performance from corpus export
hypothesis: The M595 corpus runner can export separate train and validation capability corpora with non-empty same-corpus pair rows, preserving P0 actor inputs and producing enough data for a later objective smoke.

both corpora have student_obs_dim 72 action_dim 3 target_dim 3
research validation and focused tests pass
failure_criteria: any corpus has zero pair rows
a checkpoint is trained or promoted
